page.layout: One printed page, title page, centred lines throughout; an engraved ornament with a stamp in the middle, no text columns or margin notes.
page.notes: The engraving shows a female head with flowers and drapery, and a circular library stamp reading "B.R. NEAPOLIS" overlaps it on the right; the stamp is not transcribed. Handwritten "2" at top right and a pencilled mark at the bottom are not transcribed. The imprint line reads "GRONINGÆ, 1652" with the year partly obscured by a rule; the date "1652" in the imprint is as printed. The "Groningæ" line shows "GRONING Æ, ı 652" with the numeral partly illegible: [?]. The final line is read as "pographi in Platea Cygnea 1652."
